bg-22-01.hint: I have tried eating Korean food.
bg-22-01.why: -아/어 보다 means to try doing an action: 먹- + -어 봤어요.

bg-22-01.q: Write one sentence asking a friend if they have tried kimchi using 김치 and 먹어 봤어요.
bg-22-01.why: Attach -어 봤어요? to ask if someone has tried eating something.

base.en: I have tried eating the food.

steps.en: I have tried eating Korean food.
I have tried eating delicious Korean food.

ko: 저는 지난주에 한국 문화 축제에 갔어요.
색깔이 참 곱고 예뻐서 사진을 많이 찍었어요.
en: I went to a Korean culture festival last week.
At the festival, I tried wearing a Hanbok for the first time.
The colors were so graceful and pretty that I took many photos.

bg-22-01.q: What did the writer try wearing at the festival?
bg-22-01.why: The text states '처음으로 한복을 입어 봤어요' (I tried wearing a Hanbok for the first time).

bg-22-01.q: Why did the writer take many photos?
options: Because the colors were graceful and pretty
bg-22-01.why: The text states '색깔이 참 곱고 예뻐서 사진을 많이 찍었어요' (The colors were so graceful and pretty that I took many photos).

items: Express trying new foods, clothes, and activities with -아/어 보다
Ask and answer questions about past trial experiences with -아/어 봤어요

bg-22-02.hint: I have been to Seoul before.
bg-22-02.why: -(으)ㄴ 적이 있다 expresses life experience: 가- + -ㄴ 적이 있어요.

bg-22-02.q: Write one sentence saying you have never ridden skis using 스키 and 탄 적이 없어요.
bg-22-02.why: To state lack of experience, use [Verb-(으)ㄴ] 적이 없어요.

base.en: I have been to Seoul before.

steps.en: I went to Seoul once when I was young.
I went to Seoul with my family once when I was young.

ko: 저는 여행을 좋아하지만 제주도에는 간 적이 없어요.
제 친구 유키 씨는 작년에 제주도에 다녀왔어요.
올해 여름방학에는 꼭 제주도에 가 보고 싶어요.
en: I like traveling, but I have never been to Jeju Island.
My friend Yuki visited Jeju Island last year.
This summer vacation, I really want to try going to Jeju Island.

bg-22-02.q: Has the writer ever been to Jeju Island?
bg-22-02.why: The text states '제주도에는 간 적이 없어요' (I have never been to Jeju Island).

bg-22-02.q: When does the writer want to visit Jeju Island?
bg-22-02.why: The text states '올해 여름방학에는 꼭 제주도에 가 보고 싶어요' (This summer vacation, I really want to try going).

items: Talk about life experiences using -(으)ㄴ 적이 있다 / 없다
Drop ㄹ in verbs like 살다 (산 적이 있어요) when describing past living experiences

bg-22-03.hint: I have been to Jeju Island before.
bg-22-03.why: -아/어 본 적이 있다 combines trial experience with life history.

bg-22-03.q: Write one sentence stating that you have watched Korean dramas before using 본 적이 있어요.
bg-22-03.why: 보다 + -ㄴ 적이 있어요 becomes 본 적이 있어요.

base.en: I have been to Jeju Island.

steps.en: I have been to Jeju Island before.
I have been to Jeju Island with my family before.

ko: 민수 씨, 매운 떡볶이 먹어 본 적이 있어요?
en: Minsu, have you ever tried spicy tteokbokki?
Yes, I tried eating it with friends in Myeongdong.
It was spicy at first, but really delicious.

bg-22-03.why: Minsu confirms: '네, 친구들과 명동에서 먹어 봤어요' (Yes, I tried eating it with friends in Myeongdong).

bg-22-03.q: How did Minsu describe the food?
options: Spicy at first, but really delicious
bg-22-03.why: Minsu says '처음에는 매웠지만 정말 맛있었어요' (It was spicy at first, but really delicious).

items: Combine -아/어 보다 and -(으)ㄴ 적이 있다 naturally in conversational exchanges
Answer questions about whether you have tried certain Korean foods or visited places

answers: 이 노래 한 번 들어 보세요
bg-22-04.hint: Please give this song a listen.
bg-22-04.why: Recommending an experience uses -아/어 보세요: 듣다 changes to 들어 보세요.

bg-22-04.q: Recommend visiting Jeju Island to a friend using 제주도에 and 가 보세요.
bg-22-04.why: -아/어 보세요 warmly recommends trying an experience.

bg-22-04.wrong: 불고기가 정말 맛있으니까 꼭 먹아 보세요.
answers: 불고기가 정말 맛있으니까 꼭 먹어 보세요.
불고기가 정말 맛있으니까 꼭 먹어 보세요
bg-22-04.hint: 먹다 has the dark vowel ㅓ, attaching -어 보세요: 먹- + -어 보세요 → 먹어 보세요.
bg-22-04.why: Vowel harmony requires -어 after ㅓ: 먹어 보세요.

steps.en: Please listen to this exciting song.
Please listen to this exciting song with a friend.

ko: 한국 여행을 계획하고 있다면 부산에 꼭 가 보세요.
해운대 바다가 아주 아름답고 맛있는 해산물도 많아요.
부산에 가면 해변 열차도 한번 타 보세요.
en: If you are planning a trip to Korea, definitely go to Busan.
The Haeundae sea is very beautiful and there is plenty of delicious seafood.
If you visit Busan, try riding the coastal beach train too.

bg-22-04.q: What city does the passage recommend visiting?
bg-22-04.why: The text says '부산에 꼭 가 보세요' (Definitely go to Busan).

bg-22-04.q: What activity in Busan is recommended?
bg-22-04.why: The passage suggests '해변 열차도 한번 타 보세요' (Try riding the coastal beach train too).

items: Warmly recommend experiences to friends using -아/어 보세요
Conjugate regular and ㄷ-irregular verbs (듣다 → 들어 보세요) correctly with -아/어 보세요
